[14] The drop in exports was particularly pronounced in key Asian markets, with shipments falling by 73% to China, 60% to Taiwan, and 30% to the Philippines. [14] Amid these supply and export dynamics, the market saw varied price movements in June. Prices for chicken wings and thighs were reported as stable. [14] However, broader price indicators were conflicting; one wholesale price index showed a decrease from $1.515 per unit on May 31 to $1.401 on June 30, while a separate spot price index recorded a slight increase from $1.709 to $1.715 in the same period.
